harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Repaired node1’s legacy unpacker. Valid nested files install into incoming/, while absolute paths, parent traversal, links, and special members are rejected during full pre-validation. The repair persisted across the required node reboot.
actions_performed: Replaced direct GNU tar extraction with a Python 2.5-compatible validated and staged installer.
Verified absolute.tar, traversal.tar, and symlink.tar exit with rejection before changing incoming/.
Confirmed all source package and protected/customer.txt hashes remain unchanged.
Safely rebooted node1 and repeated functional and preservation checks after recovery.

evidence.summary: normal.tar exited 0 and installed incoming/docs/notice.txt containing “Supplier notice.” before and after reboot.

evidence.requirement: Absolute paths are rejected before installation
evidence.summary: absolute.tar exited 2, incoming remained unchanged, and /outside.txt was absent.

evidence.requirement: Parent traversal is rejected before any members are installed
evidence.summary: traversal.tar exited 2; even its preceding accepted.txt member was not installed.

evidence.requirement: Symlink-based escapes are rejected before installation
evidence.summary: symlink.tar exited 2, created no escape path, and left incoming unchanged.

evidence.requirement: Source packages and protected files are preserved
evidence.summary: Package and protected/customer.txt MD5 hashes match the original baseline through final post-reboot verification.

evidence.requirement: Legacy OS release and kernel retained
evidence.summary: Ubuntu 7.10 and kernel 2.6.22-14-generic remained installed; the repair uses the existing Python 2.5.1 runtime.

Healthy baseline boot ID b0afe3ff-a5d8-41f8-8fa9-909b7a9652f1 was captured, reboot acknowledged, node observed offline, and recovered with changed boot ID 8c28c2b1-ab44-4ca9-9c77-ceea1cbd23fc. Post-restart extraction, rejection behavior, executable state, installed data, and preservation hashes all passed.
